# Differential font fixture

`reference.ttf` is the immutable input shared by the M2.8 FontTools and HarfBuzz comparisons. It
is generated by `build_reference_font.py`, not copied from an operating-system font package.

The fixture intentionally contains:

- six stable Glyph IDs, including `.notdef` and an empty `space` outline;
- three simple outlines with explicit bounds and contour points;
- a two-child composite and a nested composite with a shared descendant;
- an exact F2DOT14 `0.5` component scale;
- BMP format-4 mappings and a supplementary format-12 mapping;
- default and non-default format-14 variation sequences.

The committed file has SHA-256 digest
`3358fe5c7bd7d476f348faeb9888250929405d345c1d21d468cd93faf53618a2` when generated with
FontTools 4.55.3. Semantic equivalence is required across FontTools versions; byte identity is
checked before accepting a fixture refresh.

To rebuild it, use a Python environment containing FontTools:

```sh
python3 crates/cli/tests/fixtures/build_reference_font.py
shasum -a 256 crates/cli/tests/fixtures/reference.ttf
```

Then run all three comparison layers:

```sh
cargo +1.85.0 test -p glyphweave-cli --test reference_fixture
cargo +1.85.0 test -p glyphweave-cli --test fonttools_differential
cargo +1.85.0 test -p glyphweave-cli --test subsetter_differential
```

The first layer always runs. Live cases report a skip when `ttx`, `pyftsubset`, or `hb-subset` is
not installed; a present reference tool must exit successfully and agree semantically. Fixture,
generator, expected Rust semantics, and this digest must be reviewed together.
